# Results -- Study 254 (WSB-Mentions) on the real meme tape

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). Recipe: at each
month-end, rank a 14-name meme basket by this month's hardcoded r/WallStreetBets
mention count; long the loud half, short the quiet half; hold 1 month (one-month
execution lag) and rebalance. Pinned against the equal-weight basket and a
random-portfolio control of the same loud-leg size. Prices are **price-only**
(Yahoo monthly adjusted close); the basket deliberately keeps delisted blow-ups
(WISH/BBBY) -- where a name has no price it drops from that month's cross-section,
which **flatters** any short-the-hype result. As-of **2026-06-17**.*

## Data stamp

| Source | Window | Shape | Fingerprint (last row) |
|--------|--------|-------|------------------------|
| Hardcoded WSB mention table | 2021-01 -> 2023-12 | 36 months x 14 tickers | (curated) |
| yfinance monthly (adj close) | 2020-12-31 -> 2024-01-31 | 38 months x 14 tickers | `3bdb1bd39a46` |

Universe: ~13 names with a valid mention rank and forward return per month;
~7 in the loud leg. WISH is all-NaN on Yahoo and drops out.

## Primary specification (loud half minus quiet half, 1-month hold)

| Portfolio | Mean return | HAC *t* |
|-----------|-------------|---------|
| Loud half (high buzz) | **-25.9%/yr** | -0.85 |
| Quiet half (low buzz) | -22.4%/yr | -1.12 |
| Equal-weight basket | -23.2%/yr | -- |
| **Spread (loud - quiet)** | **-3.5%/yr = -29.3 bps/mo** | **-0.14** |
| Loud excess over basket | -2.7%/yr | -0.20 |

- The loud-minus-quiet **spread HAC *t* = -0.14** -- a statistical zero. Hit rate
  **47.2%**, indistinguishable from a coin flip.
- The block-bootstrap 95% CI on the **spread Sharpe (ann): [-1.11, +1.19]**
  (55% of resamples negative) -- the CI straddles zero.
- **The whole basket bled ~-23%/yr.** Both halves cratered; the mention rank did
  not sort the wreckage.
- The random-portfolio null sits near zero (-17 bps mean across 200 draws/month):
  the mention-sorted loud leg is no better than a random half of the basket.

## Cleanest test -- pooled rank-IC

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Spearman rank-IC (mention rank vs next-month return rank) | **-0.035** |
| p-value | 0.448 |
| (stock, month) pairs | 468 |

The mention rank does not order next-month returns. The IC is a hair below zero
and statistically indistinguishable from it.

## Sub-period analysis -- no edge in any single year

| Period | Spread/yr | HAC *t* | n months |
|--------|-----------|---------|----------|
| 2021 | -49.1%/yr | -1.01 | 12 |
| 2022 | +0.8%/yr | +0.04 | 12 |
| 2023 | +37.9%/yr | +0.76 | 12 |

No single year clears \|t\| = 2; the sign flips year to year (2021 loud names
got crushed in the post-squeeze unwind; 2023 they bounced). This is noise, not
a stable signal.

## The reversal variant -- also a zero

The folk-finance prior is "buy the rumor, sell the news": loud names should
*under*-perform. The reversal portfolio (short the loud names) earns
**+3.5%/yr, HAC *t* = +0.14** -- equally insignificant, and inflated by the fact
that delisted blow-ups drop out of the short leg.

## Tradability -- turnover and cost drag

| One-way cost | Monthly turnover | Monthly drag | Net spread | Net *t* |
|-------------|-----------------|--------------|------------|---------|
| 30 bps (illiquid + borrow) | ~7% | 4.1 bps/mo | -4.0%/yr | -0.15 |

Turnover is low (the loud half is sticky -- GME/AMC stay loud), so costs are not
even the binding constraint. There is simply no gross edge to erode. Shorting
illiquid meme names with hard-to-borrow fees in size is the practical killer.

## Positive control -- the machinery finds a link when one is planted

On the deterministic synthetic panel (`data.synthetic_panel`) the same loud-half
engine recovers a planted mention->return link with the correct sign:

| Planted premium | Spread mean/mo | Spread t-stat |
|----------------|----------------|---------------|
| +0.15 (buzz leads) | +23.1% | **+14.81** |
| 0.00 (null) | -0.8% | -0.52 |
| -0.15 (buzz fades, reversal) | -24.7% | **-16.01** |

The engine works -- it would clearly flag a real link in either direction. The
real meme tape carries none.

## Verdict

- **Signal -- NONE.** Loud-minus-quiet spread HAC *t* = -0.14; pooled rank-IC
  = -0.035 (p = 0.45); hit rate 47%; bootstrap CI straddles zero; no sub-period
  clears \|t\| = 2; the reversal sign is equally insignificant. The synthetic
  controls confirm the engine *would* detect a real link. **Endogeneity (named
  on Signal):** mentions are contemporaneous -- Reddit gets loud *because* the
  price already moved, so the proxy cannot lead the move. **Survivorship (named
  on Signal):** delisted blow-ups drop from the short leg, so even the (zero)
  headline is an upper bound. Verdict: **NONE**.
- **Tradability -- MIRAGE.** Net spread @30 bps one-way = -4.0%/yr (*t* = -0.15);
  the loud leg performs like a random half of the basket; illiquid names and
  heavy short borrow make a live implementation hopeless. There is no edge to
  trade. Verdict: **MIRAGE**.
